## Activity

During February 2020, Market Eye Clinic recorded 300 captures. This provides the activity measure for the reporting month and supports review of the service’s image capture and grading performance. The volume should be considered alongside the image quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 300 captures, 16 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.3. The result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site performance review. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be identified and followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 38 referable results during February 2020. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This provides an overall indication of the time taken for images to progress through grading during the month. Activity, image quality and grading results should be reviewed together to support ongoing operational oversight at Market Eye Clinic.
